scheme_name: Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered in any district of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must not have received assistance from any other parallel scheme of the State Government
Applicant must be an unorganized worker
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹500 per beneficiary for shoes, lifting hooks, and baskets.
